events.market_reaction: DJT spiked on debut then stayed volatile, moving heavily on Trump political/legal news.

how_to_read: Each card is Claude's read of a public Trump post: the affected ticker, whether it implies BUY / SELL / WATCH, a 0–100 strength (how explicit/emphatic the post is — NOT a profit predictor), and why. A 2-year backtest found these don't beat buy-and-hold, so this is for awareness, not trading. Not financial advice.
